func (*LoopDetectionMiddleware) Name() string

func (*LoopDetectionMiddleware) OnRunEnd(_ context.Context, runtime abi.RuntimeContext, _ error) error

func (*LoopDetectionMiddleware) OnRunStart(_ context.Context, runtime abi.RuntimeContext) error

func (DanglingToolCallMiddleware) BeforeModel(_ context.Context, _ abi.RuntimeContext, request *abi.ModelRequest) error

func (DanglingToolCallMiddleware) Name() string

func (DefaultAgentLoop) Run(ctx context.Context, config RunConfig, input []wire.Message, emit func(abi.Event) error) (runErr error)

func (ToolBatchCoordinator) Execute(ctx context.Context, config ToolBatchConfig, runID string, calls []wire.ToolCall, intents []abi.SessionRecord, tools map[string]abi.Tool, runtime *ContextRuntime, emit func(abi.Event) error) error

func (ToolTimeoutMiddleware) Name() string

func (middleware *LoopDetectionMiddleware) AfterModel(_ context.Context, runtime abi.RuntimeContext, message *wire.Message) error

func (middleware ToolTimeoutMiddleware) WrapTool(ctx context.Context, execution abi.ToolExecutionContext, call wire.ToolCall, next abi.ToolFunc) (wire.ToolResult, error)

func (model wrappedModel) Stream(ctx context.Context, request abi.ModelRequest, emit func(wire.StreamChunk) error) error

func (reader contextReader) ID() string

func (reader contextReader) Messages(ctx context.Context) ([]wire.Message, error)

func (runtime *ContextRuntime) AfterTurn(ctx context.Context) error

func (runtime *ContextRuntime) Bootstrap(ctx context.Context) error

func (runtime *ContextRuntime) Dispose(ctx context.Context) error

func (runtime *ContextRuntime) Load(ctx context.Context, log abi.ConversationReader, source abi.ContextSource) ([]wire.Message, error)

func (runtime *ContextRuntime) OnMessage(ctx context.Context, message wire.Message) error

func (runtime *ContextRuntime) Prepare(ctx context.Context, prompt []string, messages []wire.Message) ([]string, []wire.Message, error)

func (s *BoundedEventSink) Close()

func (s *BoundedEventSink) Emit(ctx context.Context, event abi.Event) error

func (s *BoundedEventSink) Events() <-chan abi.Event

func (s callbackSink) Emit(ctx context.Context, event abi.Event) error

func NewBoundedEventSink(capacity int) (*BoundedEventSink, error)

func NewContextRuntime(agentID string, system *abi.ContextSystem) *ContextRuntime

func NewLoopDetectionMiddleware(warn, hard, window int) (*LoopDetectionMiddleware, error)

type AgentLoop interface {
	Run(context.Context, RunConfig, []wire.Message, func(abi.Event) error) error
}

type BoundedEventSink struct {
}

type ContextRuntime struct {
}

type DanglingToolCallMiddleware struct{}

type DefaultAgentLoop struct{}

type DiagnosticObserver interface {
	ModelStart(context.Context, abi.ConversationLog, ModelObservation) error
	ModelEnd(context.Context, abi.ConversationLog, StreamObservation) error
	Hooks(context.Context, abi.ConversationLog, []HookTrace) error
	ReportFailure(context.Context, string, string, error)
}

type HookObservation struct {
	MiddlewareName string `json:"middleware_name"`
	LayerIndex     int    `json:"layer_index"`
	DurationMS     int64  `json:"duration_ms"`
	Outcome        string `json:"outcome"`
	ErrorSummary   string `json:"error_summary,omitempty"`
	Timing         string `json:"timing"`
}

type HookTrace struct {
	RunID      string            `json:"run_id"`
	Hook       string            `json:"hook"`
	ToolCallID string            `json:"tool_call_id,omitempty"`
	Calls      []HookObservation `json:"calls"`
}

type LoopDetectionMiddleware struct {
	OnWarning func(abi.RuntimeContext, int)
}

type ModelObservation struct {
	RunID, RequestID, SystemPrompt string
	Model                          abi.LanguageModel
	Request                        abi.ModelRequest
}

type RunConfig struct {
	State              *abi.AgentState
	Middleware         []abi.Middleware
	SystemPrompt       string
	MaxIterations      int
	MaxResponseBytes   int
	Workspace          string
	Bus                bus.Handle
	ContextSystem      *abi.ContextSystem
	ContextSource      abi.ContextSource
	MaxConcurrentTools int
	ModelConfig        wire.ModelConfig
}

type StreamObservation struct {
	RunID       string      `json:"run_id"`
	RequestID   string      `json:"request_id"`
	Events      uint64      `json:"event_count"`
	Visible     uint64      `json:"visible_event_count"`
	Text        uint64      `json:"text_delta_count"`
	Reasoning   uint64      `json:"reasoning_delta_count"`
	Tools       uint64      `json:"tool_delta_count"`
	FirstEvent  *int64      `json:"first_event_ms"`
	FirstOutput *int64      `json:"time_to_first_output_ms"`
	FirstToken  *int64      `json:"time_to_first_token_ms"`
	Duration    int64       `json:"stream_duration_ms"`
	Outcome     string      `json:"outcome"`
	FirstKind   string      `json:"first_output_kind,omitempty"`
	Usage       *wire.Usage `json:"-"`
}

type ToolBatchConfig struct {
	Diagnostics        DiagnosticObserver
	Session            abi.ConversationLog
	Middleware         []abi.Middleware
	Workspace          string
	Bus                bus.Handle
	MaxConcurrentTools int
	PreparedResults    map[string]wire.ToolResult
}

type ToolBatchCoordinator struct{}

type ToolTimeoutMiddleware struct{ Timeout time.Duration }

var ErrSinkClosed = errors.New("event sink closed")

var ErrToolTimeout = errors.New("tool exceeded timeout; waited for actual exit; side effects may have occurred")
